name: GIF Player
description: A field type/formatter that plays animated GIFs on click (paused by default).
project_description:
Gif Player Field creates a simple file field types that allows you to upload the GIF files and configure the output for this using the Field Formatters. The module uses GifPlayer jQuery library to render the GIF according to configured setups for the Field Formatter. 

 The field configuration lets you determine which elements of an GIF should be present in the field widget form and which ones should be rendered for display.

 By default the GifPlayer library is attached only to the field, but this can be configured to be used globally on the module configuration page.

The library usage is simple $('.gifplayer').gifplayer(); or visit the Library page for more configuration.

 Gif Player Field is a better version of similar Animated GIF , that uses the latest D8 conding standards and has an intuitive configurable interface for GIF field type, this being rendered according to the configuration but not as simple uploaded file.

 Compatibility notes 

Gif Player Field should work on any fieldable entity type.

 HOW TO USE 
 Install the module and add the field type the desired entity type as normal field.

 Fully developed and maintained by: Optasy
